motto: Everything worth keeping from the month just gone

curation.tasteNotes: REWRITE THIS IN YOUR OWN WORDS — it is the highest-leverage line in this file, and it outweighs the model's own taste. Say what you want to read on paper and what you always regret printing. Starting point, edit freely: I want arguments and reported pieces I will still care about in a month — how institutions actually change, education and how people learn, AI where it touches real work rather than demos. I do not want product launches, funding news, hot takes, or anything whose only value is that it is new. If a piece is mostly a link to somewhere else, leave it out.
